name: omem
description: Office Memory — local-first work-context memory layer. Lets Codex CLI query a unified local wiki built from your Mail.app / Outlook / Calendar / Microsoft 365 / local folders. Bundles the MCP server entry; OMem CLI binary must be installed separately (curl -fsSL https://github.com/seacen/omem/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh).
